data.name: Pirates Republic
data.detailed_description:
The year is 1714.

The War of the Spanish Succession is over. Tens of thousands of sailors have been cast out by the British Navy with nothing but the sea skills they earned in 12 years of war. Some chose poverty. Others chose Nassau.

In Pirates Republic, you are one of them. Arrive on the shores of Nassau with nothing and build your legend from the ground up - as a cunning captain, a feared raider, or a charismatic leader of the first free republic in the Western world.

This is not just a game about naval battles. It's a game about the people who built a society from scratch - people who wanted to live on their own terms. Your story begins with survival and ends wherever your ambition takes you.

No fantasy. No magic. Just history.

START WITH NOTHING, BUILD EVERYTHING

Wash ashore with empty hands. Find food and shelter before nightfall. Build your first home, then an entire settlement. Construction works piece by piece - place walls, floors, roofs, and furniture however you want. Every building you raise is yours, shaped by your decisions and creativity.

A NEW WORLD EVERY TIME

Every playthrough generates a unique Caribbean. Resources, NPC settlements, traders, hideouts, and treasure locations are all procedurally placed across the map. No two games play the same way.

FEED YOUR CREW OR LOSE THEM

Every voyage needs planning. Cook meals, stock supplies, and count your calories - literally. The game tracks nutritional intake for you and your crew based on real caloric values. A varied diet keeps everyone sharp. Poor nutrition slows you down, weakens your fighters, and spreads disease. Run out of food at sea and scurvy will do what cannonballs couldn't. Preparing for a long expedition is half the battle.

BUILD YOUR FLEET FROM OVER 500 COMBINATIONS

Design your ships from the keel up using a modular building system. Hull shape, mast configuration, deck layout, oar capacity - every choice affects speed, durability, and combat performance. Combine parts to create over 500 unique vessel configurations, from nimble canoes to heavily armed frigates. Equip them with dozens of weapon types - from light swivel guns to devastating heavy cannons - and watch your choices matter in every broadside.

FIGHT ON DECK, ON LAND, AND AT SEA

Combat in Pirates Republic is brutal and personal. Board enemy ships and fight blade to blade with swords, axes, and improvised weapons. Draw your flintlock pistol or musket when you need to drop someone before they reach you. On the water, maneuver your ship into position and unleash devastating broadsides. Every engagement plays differently - whether you're dueling a rival captain on a burning deck or defending Nassau's walls against a full-scale naval assault.

LEAD A LIVING SETTLEMENT

Nassau grows with your Fame. Every NPC who arrives has a unique appearance, backstory, skills, and personality - all procedurally generated. Build relationships, recruit crews, romance allies, and manage a democratic society where your people expect fair shares and strong leadership. Fail them, and they'll maroon you on a desert island.

DEFEND WHAT YOU'VE BUILT

Plunder too aggressively and the royal fleets of England and Spain will come for you. Build fortifications, line the harbor with cannons, and rally your crew - because if the navy makes it ashore, it's over. Balance your ambitions against the ever-rising threat of retaliation.

PLAY YOUR WAY - SOLO OR CO-OP

Play alone with a dedicated story questline, or team up with up to 4 friends online. Divide roles - one steers the ship, another loads the cannons, while someone else manages the settlement back home. The Caribbean is vast enough for everyone.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Open-world survival sandbox set in the historical Bahamas, 1714 - no fantasy, no magic

  • Procedurally generated game world - unique map, NPCs, quests, and events every playthrough

  • Freeform building system - construct your settlement and ships piece by piece

  • Over 500 ship combinations from modular parts with dozens of naval weapon types

  • Melee combat with swords, axes, and improvised weapons plus ranged combat with flintlock pistols and muskets

  • Realistic nutrition system - cook meals, plan supplies, and manage caloric intake for you and your crew

  • Naval combat with modular ship damage, boarding, and cannon warfare

  • Procedurally generated NPCs with unique stories, skills, and personalities

  • Fame and Disgrace system that shapes how the world reacts to you

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players on persistent servers

  • Dynamic weather including tropical storms and hurricanes

  • Historical setting inspired by the real Republic of Nassau and the golden age of piracy

data.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.
